content.short: Red Team provides smart contract audits and security assessments for Web3.
content.description: Red Team provides a comprehensive suite of cybersecurity services for blockchain and Web3 ecosystems, spanning networks from Ethereum and Arbitrum to Solana and Aptos. Core offerings include smart contract audits, penetration testing, and security testing for web and mobile applications. The team also conducts cloud security assessments, digital forensics, and on-chain analysis and monitoring, with the aim of strengthening security across traditional IT operations and Web3 environments.
content.meta: Red Team offers smart contract audits and other cybersecurity assessments for Web3. Discover Red Team and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
